entries.text: JoinOrder DataFrame queries now join the most selective tables first, apply every join predicate as a join key instead of filtering a larger intermediate afterwards, read only the columns a query uses, and on pandas fetch output-only columns after the joins. At scale 1 the Polars power phase peaks near 5 GiB instead of 9 GiB and finishes in about 2 minutes instead of 7, DataFusion peaks near 3 GiB instead of exceeding 7 GiB and the 20 minute cell limit, and pandas runs all 113 queries within 8 GiB.
